                         Project Development Objectives
                         Agriculture Production Support Project (P126576)
                         Project Development Objective (from Project Appraisal Document)
                         Project development objective: To support rural communities and producer organizations in increasing (i) the production of selected crops and livestock species in
                         selected areas of the Recipient’s territory; and (ii) the use of sustainable land and watermanagement practices in climate vulnerable ecosystems.
                         Has the Project Development Objective been changed since Board Approval of the Program?

                            Yes           No

                         Overall Implementation Progress (IP)   Satisfactory                       Moderately Satisfactory
                         Overall Risk Rating                    Substantial                        High

                         Implementation Status Overview
                         1. The Project was approved by the Board of Executive Directors on May 17, 2012, and the Grant Agreements were signed on July 13, 2012. Due to the fact that all effectiveness
                         conditions were not fulfilled in October 10, 2012, i.e. 90 days following the agreement signature, a new effectiveness date has been set for January 10, 2013 upon request from the
                         Government. This ISR has been prepared based on the findings of the second implementation support mission carried out from October 22 to 26, 2012. The Aide Memoire and
                         management letter are attached to the ISR.

                         2. Effectiveness declaration status.
                         (a) Each of the Financing Agreement, GEF Grant Agreement and LDCF Grant Agreement has been executed and delivered and all conditions precedent to its effectiveness or to the
                         right of the Recipient to make withdrawals thereunder (other than the effectiveness of this Agreement) have been fulfilled: All agreements were signed on July 13, 2012 (fulfilled);
                         (b) The Recipient has adopted the Project Implementation Manual (PIM): the PIM has been prepared by FAO and Bank's has provided its comments. It is now being finalized by the
                         project team for its adoption (near completion);
                         (c) The Steering Committee (PSC) has been established and staffed: The Arrêté creating the PSC has been signed by the Ministry of Economy (fulfilled).
                         (d) The Project Coordination Unit (PCU) has been established and staffed: The national PCU and the regional PCUs were created by Arrêté before Board approval. Recruitment of
                         core project staff has started (in progress).

                         3. Implementation Preparedness: There is no disbursement conditions therefore disbursement should start when effectiveness conditions is declared. In this perspective,the PCU has
                         prepared an eighteen-month Action Plan and a Procurement Plan which have been reviewed by the Bank. These documents will be sent to the Bank for a non-objection.


                         Locations
                         No Location data has been entered

                         Key Decisions Regarding Implementation
                         1. The PIM has been prepared by the FAO team and comments have been provided by the Bank. A national workshop including all key stakeholders will be organized shortly to
                         review and adopt the PIM by November 30, 2012.

                         2. The consulting firm in charge of selecting project staff has started the selection process which is due by the end of December 2012.

                         3. The Government should ratify the credits/grants agreement. The process is underway and the Government has been urged to finalize the ratification process by the end of
                         December 31, 2012.

                         Restructuring History
                         There has been no restructuring to date.
